info.title: AI-Valid API
info.description: Audits how readable and actionable a website is for AI agents, crawlers and generative search. Returns a weighted readiness score, a per-category breakdown, every individual check, and a ranked list of the highest-impact fixes.

get.description: Runs ~25 probes against the target origin: crawler policy (robots.txt, sitemap), content structure and structured data, delivery headers, and agent protocol manifests (llms.txt, AGENTS.md, MCP, A2A, API catalogs). Only publicly reachable http(s) origins are accepted; requests resolving to private or internal addresses are refused. Send Accept: text/markdown, or format=md, for a human-readable report instead of JSON.

parameters.name: targetUrl
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the site to audit. Only the origin is used; paths are ignored.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response representation. Defaults to JSON; 'md' returns a Markdown report. Equivalent to the Accept header.

parameters.name: bypassCache
parameters.description: Set to true to re-run the audit instead of serving a cached result for the same origin.

schema.description: The same audit rendered as a Markdown report.

400.description: The targetUrl is missing, malformed, or the origin is unreachable.

403.description: The target resolves to a private or otherwise restricted network address.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Honour the Retry-After header.

post.summary: Model Context Protocol endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0 over streamable HTTP).
post.description: Speaks MCP so agent runtimes can call the auditor as a tool. Supports initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call; the single tool is audit_website. Prefer this over /api/audit when connecting from an MCP client.

405.description: Method not allowed; this endpoint accepts POST.

durationMs.description: How long the audit took, in milliseconds.

priorities.description: The highest-weight failing checks, most impactful first.

Score.description: The weighted readiness score. Advisory policy checks are excluded from both numerator and denominator.

max.description: Always 100; total is already a percentage.

categories.description: Per-category subscores, keyed by category name.

prompt.description: A ready-to-use remediation prompt, already carrying the audited origin and this finding.

CheckGroup.description: One section of the audit. Boolean summary fields vary by section; results is always present.

status.description: ok passes, warn is partial or gated, err is a miss.

code.description: Short outcome label, e.g. Found, Missing, Soft 404, Protected.

weight.description: Points this check contributes to the score; 0 for advisory checks.

category.description: Which category subscore this check belongs to.

advisory.description: True when the check reports a policy choice rather than a defect, and is therefore excluded from the score.

prompt.description: A ready-to-use remediation prompt for this finding.
